sources.source_name: QuranEnc Arabic Language - Meanings of Words (As-Siraj fi Bayan Gharib Al-Quran)
sources.notes: Official QuranEnc identifies arabic_seraj as v1.0.0 and permits republication only under source-specific conditions. Those terms include no content modification, attribution/version retention, transcript-information retention, and an obligation to update according to newer source versions. That ongoing-update condition is not yet proven compatible with this project's requirement to keep immutable historical snapshots publicly redistributable for long-term reproducibility. Do not capture or mirror production bytes until QuranEnc clarifies archival retention or an equivalent legally durable basis is documented. If archival permission is later cleared, the existing release_requirements still require a source-bound latest-version review before an approved pack may ship.

Licence ambiguity requires resolution before promotion: the official download page presents GNU GPL/verbatim-copy terms, while the official FAQ also describes the data as research/non-commercial. Treat as non-production until the project obtains clarification or a clearly compatible authoritative licence basis.

Official SinaLab resource catalogue labels the Quran morphology dataset CC-BY-4.0, and the 2025 authors describe 77,429 word-level tokens with lemma/POS annotations and chapter:verse:word coordinates. The official download form currently grants the free edition only to users affiliated with a recognized company, university, or institution using a professional official email. No exact artifact was acquired or mirrored in this project. The paper reports 6,235 verses while the current Tanzil Evidence Plane has 6,236 ayah coordinates, so exact-byte coordinate coverage and alignment must be verified before any production promotion or word-tap integration.

Official HadeethEnc currently identifies Arabic v1.7.0 and its download surface permits republication only under source-specific conditions, including no modification, attribution/version retention, transcript-information retention, and an obligation to update according to newer source versions. That ongoing-update condition is not yet proven compatible with this project's requirement to keep immutable historical snapshots publicly redistributable for long-term reproducibility. Do not capture or mirror source bytes until HadeethEnc clarifies archival retention or an equivalent legally durable basis is documented. If archival permission later clears, preserve the exact then-current artifact and terms, verify edition/collection/numbering provenance, and apply the separate latest-version release review before any production pack ships.

Not suitable as a critical permanent mirrored source under the Developer Terms updated 2026-09-14, including redistribution/storage constraints. May be an optional online integration where those terms are satisfied.

Evaluate individual resources only. Official QUL morphology pages expose downloadable word-location keyed datasets, while the QUL FAQ requires checking dataset-specific licensing for commercial use. The QUL repository MIT licence is not treated as blanket permission for aggregated dataset bytes.
